name: Calor
summary: In Darkshire, Calor directs efforts to defend Duskwood from worgen. Under Jonathan Carevin, he helps the Carevin family hunt the beasts stalking the forests.

sections.title: A Loyalist in the Shadows
sections.body: In Darkshire, Calor supports the Carevin family's fight against the terrors closing in on town. He works with Jonathan Carevin, one of Darkshire's defenders, to eradicate the supernatural horrors before the remaining townsfolk are slaughtered.

sections.title: The Worgen Menace
sections.body: Calor sends fighters after the worgen prowling Duskwood, especially near the Rotting Orchard. These ferocious wolf-men are more dangerous than common beasts, and they slaughter travelers and patrols alike. Calor calls on capable fighters to thin their ranks and investigate their origins, hoping to stem their attacks.

faq.answer: Calor lives in Darkshire and supports the Carevin family. He helps defend the town by sending fighters after dangerous threats in Duskwood.
Calor is in Darkshire, the Alliance town in the forests of Duskwood.

faq.q: What is Calor's relationship with Jonathan Carevin?
faq.answer: Calor supports the Carevin family and follows Jonathan Carevin's direction in the fight against monsters in the forest.

faq.q: What enemies does Calor have you fight?
faq.answer: Calor sends fighters to hunt worgen in the woods, especially near the Rotting Orchard.

faq.q: Why is the worgen threat so urgent in Duskwood?
faq.answer: The worgen are vicious predators that attack anything on sight. Without regular culls, they would quickly overrun Darkshire's thin defenses; Calor coordinates efforts alongside the Night Watch.

faq.q: Is Calor a member of the Night Watch?
faq.answer: No. Calor grew disillusioned with what he saw as the Night Watch's complacency and joined Jonathan Carevin, supporting the Carevin family's fight against worgen.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can help Calor defend Darkshire's isolated townsfolk in the gloomy woods.
As a hunter, you can work with Calor to track and cull savage beasts that defy the forest's natural order.
